changes.reason: The answer resolves the shortage quantity as the maximum available warriors and the destinations as eligible recruiters. In this Marquise Recruit question, the second-person instruction to choose identifies the Marquise player as the chooser; no other actor is introduced. Recruit is an expressly named, defined action. Under 6.5.3 each recruiter supplies one normal placement opportunity. The shortage question and the answer both operate within that procedure: choosing among eligible recruiters selects which normal recruiter placements are filled when not all can be filled. The answer neither replaces Recruit with a free distribution action nor affirmatively permits stacking multiple warriors at one recruiter. Accordingly, repeating one warrior per recruiter would clarify the ordinary Recruit context but is not an additional unresolved requested quantity/location fact in this narrowly stipulated shortage branch. This acceptance relies on the technical meaning of the named action and the answer's eligible-recruiter selection wording, not on borrowing a separate answer or inventing an absent exceptional allowance. The key's once-per-turn reminder is also contextual here. The actual requested shortage facts are present, source-correct, and supported by the summary.
